notes.title: Recent Update Plan
notes.notes:
The new character : Huntress.
Skills system and talents tree are all new.
New game items and stages.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166188/f23a126007933ef1408ef25078ff244a7841efe5.jpg

notes.title: patch
notes.notes:
1. Fixed character parsing errors in non-English and Simplified Chinese operating systems.
2. Some interface issues

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
1. Controller player's key prompt method changed from original text to icons
2. The function of the controller's cross key has been changed from item control to player control
3. Skills value adjustment.
4. The player's initial movement speed is slightly increased

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue that village collision is invalid.
2. Skills value adjustment.
3. Added the set equipments "Wind Spike"

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed some terrain issues.
2. Fixed the problem that skill "Healing Posture" is invalid.
3. Fixed statue collision issue.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: The game reduces the initial difficulty.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
1. The init player skill tree slots will open A-A-B and A-B (previous only A-B)
2. The player's character strength has been slightly increased at each level.
3. Fixed a bug where item seller's items would not refresh.
4. Fixed a bug where the character panel would not refresh.
5. Some other minor fixes.
